name: Spec Pilot
description: Guides OpenSpec changes from proposal to archive, with no code before approval
about: Spec Pilot brings OpenSpec's spec-driven loop to any repository. Describe an idea and it reads your code, drafts a proposal with testable requirements and a task list, then waits for your approval before writing any code. It implements on a branch, checks every scenario against the result, and leaves all changes uncommitted for you.
features: Draft specs with testable WHEN/THEN scenarios
Implement approved tasks on a branch, uncommitted
examplePrompt: Add rate limiting to the login endpoint. Write the spec first and wait for my approval before touching any code.
